metadata.description: Sentinel Watchdog: an agent network that reports and classifies large WETH transfers watched by an autonomous Reactive Network sentinel. The on-chain Sentinel (Lasna testnet, chain 5318007) subscribes to WETH Transfer events on Base Sepolia (chain 84532); transfers at or above the threshold are counted and a callback alert is delivered to SentinelCallback on Base Sepolia. Agents in this network read that public on-chain state and explain it.

sly_data.comment: This network carries no private context. No sly_data fields are defined, so nothing private can pass between agents or sites (deny-by-default, per MVP Profile 0.2).

function.description: Front agent. Answers questions about the large transfers the Sentinel has flagged and the alerts it raised, using fresh on-chain reads and a deterministic classification.

question.description: The visitor's question about the watched transfers or alerts.

tools.instructions: You are the public front agent of the Sentinel Watchdog network. Always ground your answer in a fresh read from chain_reader, then ask interpreter to classify the state before you answer. Quote exact counts and amounts, name the chains and the contract address, and say clearly when data comes from the last verified snapshot instead of a live read. Never invent transfers, prices, or outcomes that the on-chain state does not show.

llm_info.model_name: optional - any OpenAI-compatible model via visitor BYOK; the deterministic path needs no LLM

tools.name: sentinel_watchdog

function.description: Reads the public state of the Sentinel contract on Lasna and the SentinelCallback contract on Base Sepolia through the site actions read_sentinel_state and read_callback_state (public JSON-RPC eth_call / eth_getBalance, no keys, no wallet).

tools.instructions: Call both site actions and return their results unchanged as structured data: largeSellCount, lastLargeSellAmount (wei), lastLargeSellBlock, lastCronBlock, threshold (wei), sentinelBalance (wei, lREACT) from Lasna; lastAlertCount, lastAlertAmount (wei), lastAlertBlock from Base Sepolia. If a read fails, return the runtime's last verified snapshot and mark it as such.
tools.name: chain_reader

site_actions.name: read_sentinel_state
site_actions.purpose: Read Sentinel getters and contract balance on Lasna (chain 5318007) via public JSON-RPC.

site_actions.name: read_callback_state
site_actions.purpose: Read SentinelCallback getters on Base Sepolia (chain 84532) via public JSON-RPC.

function.description: Classifies the latest watchdog state with published deterministic rules: QUIET (no flagged transfer), NOISE (barely above threshold), ELEVATED (>=10x threshold), LARGE MOVE (single transfer >=50x threshold), DUMP_CASCADE (>=3 flagged transfers). Also checks loop integrity: lastAlertCount should equal largeSellCount.

state.description: The structured state returned by chain_reader.

tools.instructions: Apply the published rules exactly; do not soften or exaggerate the verdict. Report the verdict, the amount-to-threshold ratio, and whether every flagged transfer produced a callback alert (loop integrity).
tools.name: interpreter
